scenarios.precondition: No organization exists for this email
scenarios.operation: Sign up: create the organization and its first admin in one request
scenarios.expected: The token carries sub + org_id; a second signup with the same email is rejected; there is no public join

scenarios.precondition: Administrator is authenticated in an owned organization
scenarios.operation: Invite a member with the usher qualification and let them try to invite someone
scenarios.expected: Invitations are single-use and a qualification does not grant administrator access
evidence: tests/test_lab2_qualifications.py is skipped until Lab M5 step 2 un-skips and fixes it; until then an usher is checked by hand

scenarios.precondition: Two organizations exist in one database, each with an event
scenarios.operation: A member of one organization reads and patches the other organization's event
scenarios.expected: Read and write are denied with 404 and the row is unchanged
evidence: tests/test_lab1_isolation.py is skipped until Lab M5 step 1 un-skips and fixes it; `make demo` shows the leak

scenarios.precondition: A published six-week roster exists for the food bank fixture
scenarios.operation: Block both coordinators for week 4 and attempt publication
scenarios.expected: Regeneration must not publish an incomplete roster; the prior roster stays live
evidence: mini-flow has no solver or publication endpoint; the coordinator confirms the prior roster by hand
